description: This file defines a fixed-length template stack class 'FLStack' and a template array list class 'ArrayList' intended for use in embedded firmware. It includes methods for stack operations such as push, pop, remove, and get, as well as array list management methods.

classes.name: FLStack
classes.description: A fixed-length stack template class supporting push, pop, remove, and get operations.

classes.name: ArrayList
classes.description: A template array list class for managing a fixed-size collection of elements with add, removeAt, and reset functionalities.

methods.name: FLStack()
methods.description: Constructor initializing the stack and zeroing out the internal array.

methods.name: push()
methods.description: Pushes a value onto the stack if not overflowing.

methods.name: pop()
methods.description: Removes and returns the top element of the stack.

methods.name: get()
methods.description: Returns the element at a specific index.

methods.name: reset()
methods.description: Resets the stack to an empty state.

methods.name: remove()
methods.description: Removes a specific value from the stack, if present.

methods.name: size()
methods.description: Returns the current number of elements in the stack.

methods.name: removeAt()
methods.description: Removes an element at a specific index by swapping with the last element.

methods.name: reset()
methods.description: Resets the array list to an empty state.

methods.name: add()
methods.description: Adds a new element to the array list if there is space.
